video.title: AI欧腐《花花公子？被顶级杀手驯服了！/Playboy? Tamed by DEADLIEST Assassin!》
video.desc:
Deadly assassin Noah returns to avenge his mother and reclaim her stolen company. To earn the help he needs, he becomes bodyguard and tutor to spoiled heir Ryan—the stranger he hooked up with the night before. As enemies close in, their battle of wills turns into love, and Ryan discovers his “nerdy” guard is the underworld’s feared Peregrine.
顶级杀手 Noah 归来，誓要为母亲复仇，夺回被人侵吞的公司。为了换取所需的助力，他成了纨绔继承人 Ryan 的保镖兼家教——而这个人，正是他前一晚刚睡过的陌生人。随着敌人步步逼近，两人的较劲渐渐变成了爱情，Ryan 也终于发现，自己那个"书呆子"保镖，竟是地下世界闻风丧胆的"游隼"。
